text:
anna.p: Quick internal heads-up 10: HelioHealth signed a 3-year renewal + ISV listing on Azure Marketplace. Renewal ARR is ~$310k, and they moved their inference workload from hybrid to our Private VPC connector. Big thanks to @miles_h and @tess_l for the migration runbook and SSO work. :confetti_ball:

miles_h: Great news! Migration highlights: consolidated 3 endpoints into 1 cluster, enabled kms envelope encryption, and reduced peak GPU count by ~25% via smarter batching. Will add perf graphs to the case study.

ria.k: Ops note: we used canary traffic split 10/30/60 over 3 days, no rollbacks. Documented the rollback script here: https://notion.redwood/HelioHealth-rollback (snippet below)
```
# rollback
redwoodctl deploy rollback --cluster helio-prod --to-tag v2025-02-14
```

sales_marc: Helio exec asked for a short case blurb for their press release. They want emphasis on predictability and compliance. cc @legal-bot for any redline in the marketplace terms.

legal-bot: Marketplace contract appendix reviewed. One minor PSL clause flagged; legal will provide redline by EOD Monday.

tess_l: Also adding a short "Private connector setup" cookbook to the docs site. Will include the exact quantization profile (int4) and batch config we used.

marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace listing published to staging. Please verify the listing metadata page: https://partner.microsoft.com/heliomed-redwood (staging).

anna.p: Marketing: can we coordinate a joint announcement next Thurs? Ops: please prepare a 2-slide postmortem-lite focused on migration lessons. Sales: capture renewal motion as a sales play template.

miles_h: Preliminary customer metrics: 35% token-cost reduction, 22% P95 latency improvement, and no production incidents during cutover. Adding graphs to the shared drive.

ria.k: Small ops caveat: we saw a transient PVC mount error 1.4% of requests during the first hour of the canary11 fixed by increasing fs mount timeout in the daemonset. Logged in the migration notes.

sales_marc: Nice. I'll collect the customer quote. Suggest: "Redwood gave us the control and cost savings we needed to scale clinical inference securely." Want to run that by the customer.

anna.p: Thanks all. I'll spin up the case study draft: https://notion.redwood/HelioHealth-case-study-draft. Please add short bullets (1-2 lines) for customer-facing metrics. Legal: please drop redline link when ready. Marketing: hold on press until logo + quote confirmed.

ops-bot: Post-deploy checklist passed. Monitoring alerts quiet for 72h.

miles_h: Putting together a short "technical win" doc for eng-ml about batching + KV cache changes that helped the cost numbers.

tess_l: Cake and coffee in the kitchen tomorrow 10:30 to celebrate the close. :cake:

anna.p: Awesome work team. Forwarding to execs with a short summary and ROI table.
